message: 心機一転・聖夜祭

name: Nanaka
message: 「Good work on the exams, everyone!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let us wash the past down the river along with the peaches. Now, it is the start of new Student Council activities!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Our next event is--none other than the Holy Night Festival!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Holy night... what a sweet sound that has...\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「So what are you going to do, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「I've mostly put together what I want to do, so now it's just a matter of whether I can make materials that will win the students' approval...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If it is you, Mr. President, you will be just fine」

name: Misa
message: 「Indeed. Sakura-kun can do it. Rather, I'd be troubled if he couldn't handle at least that much with ease」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, you two, aren't you overestimating Synn a bit too much?」

name: Misa
message: 「He's my rival, you know? Anything I can do, Sakura-kun should be able to do as well. That's just how it works」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is right. Trust is the very seed from which all things grow」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wha... what is with these two...?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well, whatever」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Anyway!! As long as it's fun, anything goes!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Since it's our last Holy Night Festival, I hope it turns out memorable~\s07」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course it will! Right, Sakura-kun!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Isn't that right, Mr. President!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Wha, what is up... with these two」

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-Right, Synn!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey now. That doesn't mean everyone should rely solely on Synn-kun」

name: Everyone
message: 「Y-Yeees\s01」
